about: [O1] The map against the city (brief O1 §7): at five places (each set up as a tool's teleport: Grand Ave under the el, Clock Square, the Tenements' Orchard St, the Docks' Dock Rd, the Hill's Bridge St), M by real key opens the inked map: my mark stands where I stand (its pixel on the map's ink is a street's paper, not a block's ink) and the district lettered nearest it is the one I am in; M again closes it. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_map.json

steps.eval: (window.__mapAt = (x, z, yaw) => { G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(x, z); N.controller.setPose(x, z, yaw, 0); return 1; }, window.__mapCheck = () => { const M = G.city.map, p = N.controller.pos; const [u, v] = M.map.toMap(p.x, p.z); const d = M.map.canvas.getContext('2d').getImageData(Math.round(u), Math.round(v), 1, 1).data; const D = G.stage.part('city').C.cellAt(p.x, p.z); return { at: [+p.x.toFixed(0), +p.z.toFixed(0)], uv: [Math.round(u), Math.round(v)], pixel: [d[0], d[1], d[2]], paper: d[0] > 180, open: M.isOpen, district: D && D.district }; }, 1)

steps.label: map 1: Grand Ave (downtown), my mark on the street
map 2: Clock St by the square
M closes it, the controls back, the sound untouched
